audit_chain.CONCLUSION.en: Audit verdict "{verdict}": {events} events / {docs} documents, {errors} error(s), {warns} warning(s)

audit_chain.AC-01F.en: First ingest but carries an old_sha256: doc={doc} id={id}

audit_chain.AC-02.zh: 标称源已变更但哈希未变：doc={doc} id={id} sha={sha}…

audit_chain.AC-03.zh: 标记语义过期但状态未更新：doc={doc} id={id} semantic_status={status}
audit_chain.AC-03.en: Marked semantically stale but the status was not updated: doc={doc} id={id} semantic_status={status}

audit_chain.AC-04.zh: 行数异常下降：doc={doc} id={id} 上次 {prev} 行 → 本次 {cur} 行（降幅 {pct}%）
audit_chain.AC-04.en: Line count dropped abnormally: doc={doc} id={id} {prev} lines -> {cur} lines ({pct}% drop)

audit_chain.AC-05.zh: 时间戳倒退：doc={doc} id={id} 上一条 ts={prev_ts} 本条 ts={cur_ts}

audit_chain.AC-06.zh: 引用了未经摄入建立的文档：doc={doc} 事件={event} id={id}
audit_chain.AC-06.en: References a document that was never established: doc={doc} event={event} id={id}

audit_chain.AC-OK.zh: 事件 {events} 条、文档 {docs} 个，六项核验全部通过
audit_chain.AC-OK.en: {events} events, {docs} documents; all six checks passed

points_reconcile.CONCLUSION.zh: 对账判定「{verdict}」：账本 {ledger} 条 / 账户 {accounts} 个，错误 {errors} 项、告警 {warns} 项；可用合计 {available}，冻结合计 {frozen}
points_reconcile.CONCLUSION.en: Reconciliation verdict "{verdict}": {ledger} ledger entries / {accounts} accounts, {errors} error(s), {warns} warning(s); {available} available, {frozen} frozen

points_reconcile.PR-01.zh: 账本断链：user={user} id={id} 上笔余额={prev} {entry_type} 金额={amount} 记录余额={balance} 期望={expect}
points_reconcile.PR-01.en: Ledger chain broken: user={user} id={id} previous balance={prev} {entry_type} amount={amount} recorded={balance} expected={expect}

points_reconcile.PR-02.zh: 账户余额与账本末笔不符：user={user} 账户可用={avail} 账本末笔={last}
points_reconcile.PR-02.en: Account balance disagrees with the last ledger entry: user={user} account available={avail} ledger last={last}

points_reconcile.PR-03.zh: 账户恒等式不成立：user={user} 可用+冻结={lhs} 累计授予-累计消费={rhs}
points_reconcile.PR-03.en: Account identity does not hold: user={user} available+frozen={lhs} lifetime_granted-lifetime_spent={rhs}

points_reconcile.PR-04.zh: 幂等键重复：「{key}」出现在 id={id1} 与 id={id2}
points_reconcile.PR-04.en: Duplicate idempotency key: "{key}" appears at id={id1} and id={id2}

points_reconcile.PR-05.zh: 已支付订单未入账：order={order} user={user} 积分={points}
points_reconcile.PR-05.en: Paid order has no ledger entry: order={order} user={user} points={points}

points_reconcile.PR-06.zh: 预扣未结清：user={user} reference={reference} 未结清笔数={n}
points_reconcile.PR-06.en: Reservation not settled: user={user} reference={reference} open count={n}

points_reconcile.PR-07.zh: 未知 entry_type「{entry_type}」（id={id}），按原符号处理
points_reconcile.PR-07.en: Unknown entry_type "{entry_type}" (id={id}); treated with its own sign

points_reconcile.PR-OK.zh: 账本 {ledger} 条、账户 {accounts} 个、订单 {orders} 笔，七项不变量全部成立
points_reconcile.PR-OK.en: {ledger} ledger entries, {accounts} accounts, {orders} orders; all seven invariants hold

expense_audit.CONCLUSION.zh: 审核判定「{verdict}」：明细 {items} 项合计 {total} 元；错误 {errors} 项、告警 {warns} 项
expense_audit.CONCLUSION.en: Review verdict "{verdict}": {items} line items totalling {total}; {errors} error(s), {warns} warning(s)

expense_audit.EXP-01.zh: 申报总额 {claimed} 与明细合计 {total} 不一致
expense_audit.EXP-01.en: Claimed total {claimed} does not match the line-item total {total}

expense_audit.EXP-02.zh: {name} 金额 {amount} 超过单笔上限 {limit}

expense_audit.EXP-03.zh: {name} 属「{category}」类别，金额 {amount} 超过该类别上限 {limit}
expense_audit.EXP-03.en: {name} is in category "{category}"; amount {amount} exceeds that category's limit {limit}

expense_audit.EXP-04.zh: {name} 发生日期晚于提交日期
expense_audit.EXP-04.en: {name}: the expense date is later than the submission date

expense_audit.EXP-04B.zh: {name} 距提交已 {days} 天，超过 {limit} 天报销时限
expense_audit.EXP-04B.en: {name}: {days} days since submission, beyond the {limit}-day claim window

expense_audit.EXP-05.en: {name}: category "{category}" is not on the allow-list

expense_audit.EXP-06.en: {name}: no invoice number, so it cannot be verified

expense_audit.EXP-07.zh: 模型抽取时标注了以下不确定项，需人工核对：{notes}
expense_audit.EXP-07.en: The model flagged uncertain items that need human review: {notes}

lab_report.CONCLUSION.zh: 判定「{verdict}」：共 {items} 项，异常 {abnormal} 项，危急值 {critical} 项

lab_report.LAB-01.zh: 指标由模型从报告文本抽取，共 {count} 项，请对照原报告复核
lab_report.LAB-01.en: The model extracted {count} items from the report text; check them against the original report

lab_report.LAB-02.en: {name}: the value could not be parsed, skipped

lab_report.LAB-03.zh: {name} 不在本示例参考区间表中，未判定
lab_report.LAB-03.en: {name}: not in this example's reference table, not judged

lab_report.CRIT-01.zh: {name} {value} {unit} 达危急值（{lo}~{hi}），须立即复核并报告
lab_report.CRIT-01.en: {name} {value} {unit} is a critical value ({lo}~{hi}); review and report immediately

lab_report.REF-01.en: {name} {value} {unit} is below the lower reference limit {ref}

lab_report.REF-02.en: {name} {value} {unit} is above the upper reference limit {ref}

point_table.CONCLUSION.zh: 核对判定「{verdict}」：点位 {points} 条，错误 {errors} 项、告警 {warns} 项

point_table.PT-00.zh: 点位由模型从点表文本抽取，共 {count} 条，请对照原始点表复核
point_table.PT-00.en: The model extracted {count} points from the point-table text; check them against the original

point_table.PT-01.zh: 地址重叠（功能码 {fc}）：{name_a} [{range_a}] 与 {name_b} [{range_b}]

point_table.PT-02.zh: {name} 数据类型 {dtype} 未知，无法判断寄存器数量
point_table.PT-02.en: {name}: data type {dtype} is unknown, so the register count cannot be derived

point_table.PT-03.zh: {name} 量程倒置：下限 {lo} >= 上限 {hi}
point_table.PT-03.en: {name}: inverted range, lower bound {lo} >= upper bound {hi}

point_table.PT-03B.en: {name}: the range is not numeric, so it cannot be judged

point_table.PT-04B.zh: {name} 地址 {addr} 超出 Modbus 可寻址范围 0~65535
point_table.PT-04B.en: {name}: address {addr} is outside the Modbus addressable range 0~65535

point_table.PT-06.zh: {name} 功能码 {fc} 不是合法 Modbus 功能码
point_table.PT-06.en: {name}: function code {fc} is not a valid Modbus function code

point_table.PT-OK.zh: 点位 {count} 条，未发现一致性问题

spc_control.CONCLUSION.zh: 过程判定「{verdict}」：共触发 {count} 处判异（{rules}）

spc_control.CONCLUSION_CLEAN.zh: 过程判定「{verdict}」：8 条判异准则均未触发
spc_control.CONCLUSION_CLEAN.en: Process verdict "{verdict}": none of the 8 detection rules fired

spc_control.SPC-OK.zh: {rules} 条判异准则均未触发，过程受控
spc_control.SPC-OK.en: None of the {rules} detection rules fired; the process is in control

pin_conflict.CONCLUSION.zh: 判定「{verdict}」：错误 {errors} 项，告警 {warns} 项

pin_conflict.PIN-00.zh: 存在未填引脚名的分配行
pin_conflict.PIN-00.en: There is an allocation row with no pin name

pin_conflict.PIN-01.zh: 引脚 {pin} 被同时分配给「{a}」与「{b}」
pin_conflict.PIN-01.en: Pin {pin} is assigned to both "{a}" and "{b}"

pin_conflict.PIN-02.zh: 保留了调试口引脚 {pin} 却被占用为 {signal}
pin_conflict.PIN-02.en: Debug pin {pin} is reserved but used as {signal}

pin_conflict.PIN-03.zh: 引脚命名不合法：{pin}（应为 P<端口><序号>，如 PA9）
pin_conflict.PIN-03.en: Illegal pin name: {pin} (expected P<port><number>, e.g. PA9)

pin_conflict.IRQ-01.zh: 抢占优先级 {priority} 被 {count} 个中断共用：{names}
pin_conflict.IRQ-01.en: Preemption priority {priority} is shared by {count} interrupt(s): {names}

pin_conflict.IRQ-02.zh: 中断 {irq} 优先级缺失或非整数
pin_conflict.IRQ-02.en: Interrupt {irq}: priority is missing or not an integer

pin_conflict.IRQ-02B.zh: 中断 {irq} 优先级 {priority} 超出 0~{max}

pin_conflict.DMA-01.zh: DMA 通道 {channel} 被重复声明 {count} 次

pin_conflict.DMA-02.zh: DMA 通道 {channel} 被分配给多个外设：{peripherals}
pin_conflict.DMA-02.en: DMA channel {channel} is assigned to multiple peripherals: {peripherals}

pin_conflict.RES-OK.zh: 引脚 {pins} 条、中断 {irqs} 条、DMA {dmas} 条，未发现资源冲突
pin_conflict.RES-OK.en: {pins} pins, {irqs} interrupts, {dmas} DMA entries; no resource conflicts found

salary_tax.CONCLUSION.zh: 全年应纳个税合计 {total_tax} 元（税前收入 {total_income} 元，实际税负 {rate}%）
salary_tax.CONCLUSION.en: Total income tax for the year: {total_tax} (gross income {total_income}, effective rate {rate}%)

salary_tax.TAX-YTD.zh: 按累计预扣法逐月计算，年末累计应纳 {total_tax} 元
salary_tax.TAX-YTD.en: Computed month by month with the cumulative withholding method; year-end total {total_tax}

bid_quote.CONCLUSION.zh: 建议报价 {currency} {total}（直接成本 {direct_cost}，明细来源 {source}）
bid_quote.CONCLUSION.en: Recommended quote {currency} {total} (direct cost {direct_cost}, line items from {source})

loan_dscr.CONCLUSION.zh: DSCR = {dscr}，判定「{verdict}」；可用于偿债的现金流 {cfads}，当年还本付息 {debt_service}
loan_dscr.CONCLUSION.en: DSCR = {dscr}, verdict "{verdict}"; cash available for debt service {cfads}, principal and interest {debt_service}

loan_dscr.DSCR-REVIEW.zh: DSCR {dscr} 低于 {ok} 但高于 {review}，需补充担保或调整还款计划
loan_dscr.DSCR-REVIEW.en: DSCR {dscr} is below {ok} but above {review}; extra collateral or a revised repayment schedule is required

loan_dscr.ICR-LOW.zh: 利息保障倍数 {icr} 低于 {threshold}

modbus_poll.CONCLUSION.zh: 一轮轮询 {cycle_ms} ms（合并后 {requests} 次请求），目标周期 {target_ms} ms —— 判定「{verdict}」
modbus_poll.CONCLUSION.en: One polling cycle {cycle_ms} ms ({requests} requests after merging), target {target_ms} ms — verdict "{verdict}"

modbus_poll.POLL-MERGED.zh: 合并连续寄存器后：{requests} 次请求，一轮 {cycle_ms} ms（占目标周期 {pct}%）
modbus_poll.POLL-MERGED.en: After merging adjacent registers: {requests} requests, one cycle {cycle_ms} ms ({pct}% of the target)

modbus_poll.POLL-SOLO.zh: 不做合并：{requests} 次请求，一轮 {cycle_ms} ms —— 合并省下 {saved_pct}%
modbus_poll.POLL-SOLO.en: Without merging: {requests} requests, one cycle {cycle_ms} ms — merging saves {saved_pct}%

modbus_poll.POLL-OVER.zh: 一轮 {cycle_ms} ms 超过目标周期 {target_ms} ms，余量 {margin_ms} ms（缺口 {short_ms} ms）
modbus_poll.POLL-OVER.en: One cycle {cycle_ms} ms exceeds the target {target_ms} ms; margin {margin_ms} ms (short by {short_ms} ms)

modbus_poll.POLL-SUGGEST.zh: 建议：波特率 {baud} → 115200 可把传输时间降到约 {cycle_ms} ms
modbus_poll.POLL-SUGGEST.en: Suggestion: raising the baud rate from {baud} to 115200 cuts transmission time to about {cycle_ms} ms

modbus_poll.POLL-SUGGEST-B.zh: 建议：放宽目标周期到 {target_ms} ms，或把链路拆成两条
modbus_poll.POLL-SUGGEST-B.en: Suggestion: relax the target cycle to {target_ms} ms, or split the link into two

modbus_poll.POLL-ROOM.zh: 余量 {margin_ms} ms（{pct}%）；按当前点表最多可支撑约 {max_points} 个同规模点位
modbus_poll.POLL-ROOM.en: Margin {margin_ms} ms ({pct}%); the current point table supports roughly {max_points} points of this size

modbus_poll.POLL-SLOW.zh: 最慢请求：FC{fc} 起始 {start} 共 {regs} 寄存器（{names}），{cost_ms} ms
modbus_poll.POLL-SLOW.en: Slowest request: FC{fc} starting at {start}, {regs} registers ({names}), {cost_ms} ms

firmware_budget.CONCLUSION.zh: 判定「{verdict}」：Flash {flash_used}/{flash_cap} KB（{flash_pct}%），RAM {ram_used}/{ram_cap} KB（{ram_pct}%）；错误 {errors} 项、告警 {warns} 项
firmware_budget.CONCLUSION.en: Verdict "{verdict}": Flash {flash_used}/{flash_cap} KB ({flash_pct}%), RAM {ram_used}/{ram_cap} KB ({ram_pct}%); {errors} error(s), {warns} warning(s)

firmware_budget.FR-01.zh: Flash 超容量：{used} KB / {cap} KB（超 {over} KB）
firmware_budget.FR-01.en: Flash over capacity: {used} KB / {cap} KB (over by {over} KB)

firmware_budget.FR-02.zh: Flash 占用率 {pct}%，超过告警阈值 {threshold}%（余量 {margin} KB）
firmware_budget.FR-02.en: Flash usage {pct}% exceeds the {threshold}% warning threshold ({margin} KB left)

firmware_budget.FR-02-OK.zh: Flash 占用 {used} KB / {cap} KB（{pct}%），余量充足
firmware_budget.FR-02-OK.en: Flash usage {used} KB / {cap} KB ({pct}%); ample headroom

firmware_budget.FR-03.zh: RAM 超容量：{used} KB / {cap} KB（超 {over} KB）
firmware_budget.FR-03.en: RAM over capacity: {used} KB / {cap} KB (over by {over} KB)

firmware_budget.FR-04.zh: RAM 占用率 {pct}%，超过告警阈值 {threshold}%（余量 {margin} KB）
firmware_budget.FR-04.en: RAM usage {pct}% exceeds the {threshold}% warning threshold ({margin} KB left)

firmware_budget.FR-05.zh: 任务「{task}」栈余量仅 {margin_pct}%（峰值 {peak} / 分配 {allocated} B），低于安全下限 {floor}%
firmware_budget.FR-05.en: Task "{task}": stack margin only {margin_pct}% (peak {peak} / allocated {allocated} B), below the {floor}% safety floor

firmware_budget.FR-06.zh: 任务「{task}」栈峰值 {peak} B 已超过分配 {allocated} B —— 已发生栈溢出
firmware_budget.FR-06.en: Task "{task}": stack peak {peak} B exceeds the allocated {allocated} B — a stack overflow has already occurred

bid_quote.BASIS.zh: 纯确定性计算，无外部数据依赖；上限受输入质量与假设 AS-001/AS-003 约束
bid_quote.BASIS.en: Purely deterministic computation with no external data dependency; the ceiling is bounded by input quality and assumptions AS-001/AS-003

bid_quote.BASIS-LLM.zh: 明细由模型从自然语言抽取，存在识别误差；计算部分为确定性
bid_quote.BASIS-LLM.en: The line items were extracted from natural language by a model, so recognition errors are possible; the computation itself is deterministic

expense_audit.BASIS.zh: 明细为结构化输入，判定为确定性规则
expense_audit.BASIS.en: The line items are structured input, and the judgement is a deterministic rule

expense_audit.BASIS-LLM.zh: 明细由模型从报销说明抽取，存在识别误差；合规判定为确定性规则
expense_audit.BASIS-LLM.en: The line items were extracted from the claim text by a model, so recognition errors are possible; the compliance judgement is a deterministic rule

lab_report.BASIS.zh: 参考区间为示例值，未与具体实验室报告单核对；判定逻辑为确定性规则
lab_report.BASIS.en: The reference intervals are example values and were not checked against a specific laboratory report; the judgement logic is a deterministic rule

point_table.BASIS.zh: 点位为结构化输入，检查为确定性规则
point_table.BASIS.en: The points are structured input, and the checks are deterministic rules

point_table.BASIS-LLM.zh: 点位由模型抽取，存在识别误差；一致性检查为确定性规则
point_table.BASIS-LLM.en: The points were extracted by a model, so recognition errors are possible; the consistency checks are deterministic rules

spc_control.BASIS.zh: 判异准则为公开标准；中心线与西格玛由输入或 I-MR 法确定，纯确定性
spc_control.BASIS.en: The detection rules are a public standard; the centre line and sigma come from the input or the I-MR method, fully deterministic

pin_conflict.BASIS.zh: 规则集为确定性检查，无模型参与；同一分配表必然得到同一清单
pin_conflict.BASIS.en: The rule set is a deterministic check with no model involved; the same allocation table always yields the same list

salary_tax.BASIS.zh: 规则取自《个人所得税法》7 级累进预扣率表，纯确定性计算，无外部数据依赖
salary_tax.BASIS.en: The rules come from the 7-bracket progressive withholding table of China's Individual Income Tax Law; purely deterministic, with no external data dependency

loan_dscr.BASIS.zh: 纯确定性公式；阈值来自贷款审批惯例，可在输入中覆盖
loan_dscr.BASIS.en: A purely deterministic formula; the thresholds follow lending practice and can be overridden in the input

modbus_poll.BASIS.zh: 按 Modbus 帧格式与字符时间计算，纯确定性；不含从站内部处理耗时以外的随机因素
modbus_poll.BASIS.en: Computed from the Modbus frame format and character times, fully deterministic; no randomness beyond the slave's own processing delay

firmware_budget.BASIS.zh: 汇总与容量比对为纯算术；阈值来自实践惯例且可在输入中覆盖
firmware_budget.BASIS.en: Summation and capacity comparison are pure arithmetic; the thresholds follow practice and can be overridden in the input

points_reconcile.BASIS.zh: 七项不变量为纯确定性校验，已在真实生产库上验证（违反数 0）；规则不依赖模型
points_reconcile.BASIS.en: The seven invariants are purely deterministic checks, validated against a real production database (zero violations); the rules do not depend on a model

audit_chain.BASIS.zh: 六项校验全部基于事件字段的确定性语义，不依赖模型；字段定义取自真实审计日志
audit_chain.BASIS.en: All six checks rest on the deterministic semantics of the event fields and do not depend on a model; the field definitions come from a real audit log

bid_quote.RISK-01.zh: 结论不构成报价承诺，需业务负责人签字确认
bid_quote.RISK-01.en: This conclusion is not a quotation commitment; a business owner must sign it off

bid_quote.RISK-02.zh: 管理费费率假设（AS-001）失效时结论系统性偏低
bid_quote.RISK-02.en: If the overhead-rate assumption (AS-001) fails, the conclusion is systematically low

bid_quote.RISK-02-LLM.zh: 明细来自模型抽取，请对照原始描述复核后再签字
bid_quote.RISK-02-LLM.en: The line items came from model extraction; check them against the original description before signing

bid_quote.RISK-03.zh: 未计入税费、汇率波动与工期延误
bid_quote.RISK-03.en: Taxes, exchange-rate movement and schedule slippage are not included

expense_audit.RISK-01.zh: 结论不构成付款依据，需业务负责人签字确认
expense_audit.RISK-01.en: This conclusion is not a payment authority; a business owner must sign it off

expense_audit.RISK-02.zh: 发票真伪与税额未做校验
expense_audit.RISK-02.en: Invoice authenticity and tax amounts are not checked

expense_audit.RISK-03.zh: 类别限额为示例值，需替换为企业实际制度
expense_audit.RISK-03.en: The category limits are example values and must be replaced with your organisation's actual policy

lab_report.RISK-01.zh: **本结论不构成医学诊断**，仅供参考，必须由执业医师结合临床判断
lab_report.RISK-01.en: **This conclusion is not a medical diagnosis.** It is for reference only and a licensed physician must judge it alongside the clinical picture

lab_report.RISK-02.zh: 参考区间随实验室、方法学、年龄、妊娠状态变化，示例值可能与实际报告单不符
lab_report.RISK-02.en: Reference intervals vary by laboratory, methodology, age and pregnancy status; the example values may not match an actual report

lab_report.RISK-03.zh: 模型抽取的数值存在误读风险，关键指标必须人工核对
lab_report.RISK-03.en: Values extracted by a model may be misread; critical indicators must be checked by hand

point_table.RISK-01.zh: 未校验字节序（大端/小端）与上位机实际解析设置是否一致
point_table.RISK-01.en: Byte order (big/little endian) is not checked against the host software's actual parsing settings

point_table.RISK-02.zh: 未校验从站地址与波特率等通信参数
point_table.RISK-02.en: Slave addresses, baud rates and other communication parameters are not checked

point_table.RISK-03.zh: 地址重叠判断按连续寄存器区间，未考虑厂商自定义映射
point_table.RISK-03.en: Overlap detection assumes contiguous register ranges and ignores vendor-specific mappings

spc_control.RISK-01.zh: 控制限基于历史数据，过程均值漂移后需重新计算基线
spc_control.RISK-01.en: The control limits rest on historical data; after a mean shift the baseline must be recomputed

spc_control.RISK-02.zh: R6（分层）与 R7（交替）属于异常好/周期性信号，需结合工艺判断
spc_control.RISK-02.en: R6 (stratification) and R7 (alternation) are unusually-good or periodic signals and need process knowledge to interpret

spc_control.RISK-03.zh: 样本量 {n} 偏少时 R6/R7 不会触发，属正常
spc_control.RISK-03.en: With only {n} samples, R6/R7 will not fire; that is normal

pin_conflict.RISK-01.zh: 规则集是示例，未覆盖复用功能表、时钟树与电气约束（需按具体 MCU 数据手册扩展）
pin_conflict.RISK-01.en: The rule set is an example and does not cover alternate-function tables, the clock tree or electrical constraints; extend it from the specific MCU datasheet

pin_conflict.RISK-02.zh: 引脚冲突不等于功能不可实现：部分 MCU 允许分时复用，需人工确认
pin_conflict.RISK-02.en: A pin conflict does not always mean the function is impossible: some MCUs allow time-multiplexing, so confirm by hand

salary_tax.RISK-01.zh: 未计入年终奖单独计税、劳务报酬、股权激励等特殊项目
salary_tax.RISK-01.en: Year-end bonus separate taxation, remuneration for services and equity incentives are not included

salary_tax.RISK-02.zh: 专项附加扣除以输入值为准，未做资格校验
salary_tax.RISK-02.en: Additional special deductions are taken from the input as given, with no eligibility check

salary_tax.RISK-03.zh: 各地社保基数上下限差异未体现
salary_tax.RISK-03.en: Regional differences in social-insurance base floors and ceilings are not reflected

loan_dscr.RISK-01.zh: 未考虑现金流季节性波动与建设期超支
loan_dscr.RISK-01.en: Seasonal cash-flow variation and construction-period overruns are not considered

loan_dscr.RISK-02.zh: 净利润为会计口径，与经营现金流可能背离
loan_dscr.RISK-02.en: Net profit is an accounting figure and may diverge from operating cash flow

loan_dscr.RISK-03.zh: 阈值 DSCR>={threshold} 为示例惯例，各行政策不同
loan_dscr.RISK-03.en: The DSCR >= {threshold} threshold follows example practice; policies differ between lenders

modbus_poll.RISK-01.zh: turnaround_ms 为估计值，实际从站响应间隔需现场实测（不同厂商差异可达数倍）
modbus_poll.RISK-01.en: turnaround_ms is an estimate; the real slave response interval must be measured on site (vendors can differ by several times)

modbus_poll.RISK-02.zh: 未计入网络交换机时延、无线链路重传与丢包重试
modbus_poll.RISK-02.en: Switch latency, wireless retransmission and packet-loss retries are not included

modbus_poll.RISK-03.zh: 未计入主站软件自身的调度与处理开销
modbus_poll.RISK-03.en: The host software's own scheduling and processing overhead is not included

firmware_budget.RISK-01.zh: 栈峰值为实测高水位，未覆盖尚未走到的分支；建议留足余量
firmware_budget.RISK-01.en: Stack peaks are measured high-water marks and do not cover branches not yet taken; leave ample margin

firmware_budget.RISK-02.zh: 未计入中断栈、DMA 缓冲区与运行时动态分配
firmware_budget.RISK-02.en: Interrupt stacks, DMA buffers and runtime dynamic allocation are not included

firmware_budget.RISK-03.zh: Flash 未计入未来 OTA 双分区与升级余量
firmware_budget.RISK-03.en: Flash does not account for future OTA dual-partition layout or upgrade headroom

points_reconcile.RISK-01.zh: 只校验账本与账户自身的自洽性，不校验业务语义（例如某笔授予是否该给）
points_reconcile.RISK-01.en: This checks the ledger and accounts for self-consistency only, not business semantics (for example whether a grant was warranted)

points_reconcile.RISK-02.zh: reserve/capture 配对按 reference_id 计数，跨系统对账需保证 reference_id 口径一致
points_reconcile.RISK-02.en: Reserve/capture pairing counts by reference_id; cross-system reconciliation requires a consistent reference_id convention

points_reconcile.RISK-03.zh: 未见得覆盖并发写入下的瞬时中间态（应在事务边界处对账）
points_reconcile.RISK-03.en: Transient intermediate states under concurrent writes are not covered; reconcile at transaction boundaries

audit_chain.RISK-01.zh: 只校验事件序列内部自洽，不校验文档内容是否正确
audit_chain.RISK-01.en: This checks the event stream for internal consistency only, not whether document contents are correct

audit_chain.RISK-02.zh: 哈希链按 doc_id 分组，若同一文档跨多个来源路径需先统一 doc_id 口径
audit_chain.RISK-02.en: The hash chain is grouped by doc_id; if one document spans several source paths, unify the doc_id convention first

audit_chain.RISK-03.zh: line_count 突降也可能是合法的文档精简，需人工确认
audit_chain.RISK-03.en: A sudden drop in line_count may also be legitimate trimming and needs human confirmation

spc_control.R2.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 3 点中 2 点超出同侧 2σ
spc_control.R2.en: point {index}: 2 of 3 consecutive points beyond 2σ on the same side

spc_control.R3.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 5 点中 4 点超出同侧 1σ
spc_control.R3.en: point {index}: 4 of 5 consecutive points beyond 1σ on the same side

spc_control.R4.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 8 点在中心线同侧
spc_control.R4.en: point {index}: 8 consecutive points on the same side of the centre line

spc_control.R5.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 6 点单调递增/递减
spc_control.R5.en: point {index}: 6 consecutive points monotonically increasing or decreasing

spc_control.R6.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 15 点落在 1σ 内

spc_control.R7.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 14 点交替上下
spc_control.R7.en: point {index}: 14 consecutive points alternating up and down

spc_control.R8.zh: 第 {index} 点：连续 8 点超出 1σ
